response_strategy: Respond warmly in Dutch at A1.1 level, then ask one simple question.

description: Learner asks to repeat or slow down
response_strategy: Repeat the last sentence more slowly, provide a short Ukrainian translation, then invite another attempt.

description: Learner asks what a word means
response_strategy: Explain the word in Ukrainian, give one simple Dutch example, and ask learner to make a sentence.
Acknowledge meaning, correct at most one important error, and ask one related A1 question.
Answer using simple directional language. If location facts are not supplied by the scenario, do not invent real-world directions.
In roleplay, answer with a fictional clearly contextual price; do not present it as a real current price.
Do not shame the learner. Say in Dutch that you did not understand, offer two possible phrases, and ask them to try again.
